items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I went and played with Rene to play Buddy's funeral

ctx.x: That was way back, 1931 then. Yeah.
Yeah, around about that time. About the time Buddy Petit died, do you remember? Yeah, when Buddy Petit died. It's because we played Buddy Petit's funeral, you see.
What, you were in the Eureka when you played Buddy Petit's funeral?

items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: You remember that big fella? Big babysit, but look like a type. Yeah. That's who I'm speaking of.

ctx.x: You remember when Honoré was playing with Excelsior? Dutré, Trumont player? Yeah. Sure. You remember that big fella? Big babysit, but look like a type. Yeah. That's who I'm speaking of.
